notes.title: 5/2 Patch Note

1. Character Level cap has been raised to 65, Experience required to Upgrade from levels 59 to 60 has been reduced.
2. New Class "Berserker" is now available, Class items will drop it from "Sapphire Keep (5 Players)".

3. The Dungeon "Sapphire Keep (Solo/5 Players)" is now open.A). After completing the Main Task "Lv65. Into the Breach," Player can enter the Dungeon from the entrance in "Sky City Constellacia" (720, 1322).B). There is a chance to obtain the Berserker job change item "Berserker's Awakening" when clearing the Dungeon "(Party) Sapphire Keep."

Start from "5/2 (Thu) after maintenance to 5/9 (Thu) before maintenance." During the event, spend a specified amount of points at the AP shop to receive corresponding rewards Click [url=https://www.x-legend.com/online/astraltale/en/news_in.php?nid=21255]Here[/url] for more detail

Start from "5/2 (Thu) after maintenance ~ 5/30 (Thu) before maintenance."
Characters reach Level 20 During the time of the event will automatically trigger the Task "Lv20. Unspoken Love."
Upon completion, players can undertake Mother's Day series Tasks, and by collecting enough "Sincere Heart," Can Redeem Facial Accessory Appearances or event titles!

8. The Royal City of Arcadia NPC "Exotic Merchant Sebastian" Now will selling some level 60 equipment recipes.

9. The inquiry window for acquiring more powerful equipment has added the "Do Not Show Again Today" option.

10. Fixed the issue where the "Emilia" Senshi Task achievement did not appear.

11. Remove Lil' Mo and Masquerade Event
※Unused treasure map rewards will be removed after the maintenance on 5/9 (Thu).

Further detailed Mall & Puzzle of this week, please visit [url=https://www.x-legend.com/online/astraltale/en/news_in.php?nid=21255]official Website [/url]

notes.title: 3/28 Patch Note
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Special Update[/h2][/b]
[h3]Next week coincides with consecutive holidays, Maintenance on 4/4 (Thursday) will be moved up to 4/3 (Wednesday), Please take note.[/h3]

[b][h2]Game Update[/h2][/b]

1. New (Solo) Desert Wasteland
[i]A) After completing the prerequisite task "Lv40. Turn That Frown Upside Down, "Lv40. Desert Wasteland" will be automatically triggered at Lv.40 in the "The Royal City of Arcadia."
B) After completing the guide task, you can enter the Dungeon "(Solo) Desert Wasteland" at The Royal City of Arcadia (219, 397).[/i]

2. New Senshi Task.Players can assign Senshi to the Terracottage through "Terracottage Management," and upon entering the Terracottage, can accept the Task from the Senshi.
[i]A) A single account can accept up to 5 Tasks per day.
B) Upon completing a Task, players will receive 20 points of Senshi bond value.[/i]

3. The 'Unknown Dimension' event has Return,Star from after the maintenance on 3/28 (Thu) to before the maintenance on 4/11 (Thu). Once a character reaches Level 30 during the event period, Can head to The Royal City of Arcadia (X361, Y348) to find the NPC Unknown Dimension. By following the Dialogue prompts and submitting the corresponding items, players will receive a token of appreciation from Him, with a chance to earn a special event title!
[i]※Players can reset the Unknown's receipt status by submitting 20 gold."[/i]

4. Added the "Auto-Skip Dungeon Cutscenes" featurePlayers now can select it via "System Settings" > "Gameplay" > "Display Settings".
[i]※This function is limited to skipping Dungeon cutscenes that have been viewed before.
※The scope of application is mainly for those that could previously be skipped with the ESC key.[/i]

5. The Guild has added a new NPC, "<Adventure> Rochi,"Who can Redeem the high-times Guild Community Chest with either 10 or 20 Chests.
[i]※For example: Use 10 Guild Community Chests to Redeem 1 Guild Community Chest (10x Rewards), which allows you to receive 10 times the rewards at once when opened on the Guild Airship.[/i]

6. Fixed the issue where setting the hotkey to "~" would revert to default after maintenance.

7. Adjusted the issue where CRIT rate, CRIT taken rate, CRIT damage, and damage taken from CRITs against specific types of targets were abnormal.

8. Fixed an issue where casting abilities in rapid succession with high attack speed could cause the character to get stuck.

9. Adjust the stackable number of "Chest" and "Guild Community Chest" to 100.※Magic Sealed Chestt has not been adjusted yet.

10. Next week, Will unlock the New Level cap, new scenes, and the Rogue Class. Players, please look forward to it. Start From this week's maintenance until to maintenance of next week, the experience gained from defeating monsters will increase by 50%!

Further detailed Mall & update schedule of this week, please visit [url=https://www.x-legend.com/online/astraltale/en/news_in.php?nid=20936]official Website [/url]

[h2][b]Speical Update[/b][/h2]

After this week's maintenance, An anti-cheat system with a QTE detection mechanism will be implemented. If abnormal behavior is detected, the character will be kicked out and prohibited from logging in. Repeat offenders may have their accounts banned or their devices locked. Please take note.

notes.title: Development log (Part 2)
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow gamers! We are the Astral Tale-Global production team, back to share some exciting news with you. Currently, we are working tirelessly on expansions and optimizations, aiming to bring the game to you as soon as possible!

[h3][b]New Class - Ninja[/b][/h3]
Introducing the new class "Ninja" to the mythic universe, masters of advanced shuriken techniques. Renowned for their agility and strategic thinking on the battlefield, Ninjas are designed for players who enjoy a blend of ranged and melee combat. They can execute precise long-range attacks using their keen vision, launch swift ambushes with unique body techniques, and maintain a safe distance when necessary. The Ninja class can unleash devastating area-of-effect damage with the "Swift Wind Tornado" and manipulate the environment with "Space Erosion" to gain advantages and weaken enemies simultaneously.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44696175/0da991f924ae0c4295023a4fdb49b4d919a593ee.png[/img]

[h3][b]Adjustments to the "Samurai" and "Occultist" Classes[/b][/h3]
To prevent certain classes from becoming overly dominant in specific situations, we will prioritize adjusting the settings for the Samurai and Occultist classes. This aims to address the phenomenon of many players switching to the same class during certain periods. Subsequently, we will assess and make adjustments to other classes as needed to ensure each class has a distinct role.

[h3][b]Anti-Cheat Monitoring[/b][/h3]
As with any MMO, we acknowledge the presence of illegitimate players. Therefore, we will implement detection technology similar to that used in Eden Eternal-Global to maintain fairness in the game. While we cannot guarantee 100% prevention of all illegitimate players, we will make every effort to minimize their impact on the game.

Stay tuned for upcoming pre-registration and launch events! Feel free to reconnect with your old gaming buddies and embark on a new adventure in Astral Tale together!

notes.title: Development log (Part 1)
notes.notes:
Hello, all players! This is the production team of Astral Tale.
By the time you read this, we believe you have already learned about the upcoming Global version of Astral Tale.
Currently, we are continuously working on multiple optimizations and adjustments for the game.
We hope to provide players with the best gaming experience in the most stable state possible!

In addition to what we've previously announced about introducing new professions class, there will also be some system adjustments and improvements.

[h3]Enhancement Mechanism Changes[/h3]
We are planning to adjust the values of enhancements, enhancement thresholds, and other settings. Enhancement items below five stars will be made obtainable in the game, making it easier for players to improve their equipment. Furthermore, the additional abilities gained from enhancements will be more in line with the value curve, providing a more balanced gaming experience.

[h3]Fast Travel[/h3]
This is a brand-new feature aimed at saving players time when moving around during tasks, allowing for quicker progress and significantly improving convenience.

[h3]Senshi System[/h3]
The Senshi system has also undergone some adjustments. The original limit of seven stars will be adjusted to five stars, and corresponding star values will be partially compressed or adjusted. The advanced difficulty levels will also be reduced to better align with the role of Senshi.

[h3]Appearance Customization Expansion[/h3]
In addition to the existing appearance customization options, character creation will include new options for hairstyles, faces, skin tones, eye colors, and more, allowing players to create more diverse looks.

[h3]Finally, as mentioned in our previous teaser, we are working on a completely new profession class. We hope this will bring even more fun to the players. More information will be included in our next special report, so please stay tuned![/h3]
